title: DJ Zenas Furnished An Dynamic Single Track, "Apple of My Eye"
htmlContent:
DJ Zenas is an up-and-coming artist, producer, and songwriter in the USA. He has an impressive record of creating music, including various genres such as hip-hop, rap, R&B, chill, and romantic songs. Zenas was originally from Denver, CO, and has moved to Dallas, TX.

 His latest single is "Apple of My Eye," showcasing his unique sound and style to create quality music for all types of listeners. The song has already gained attention from music critics who praised it for its catchy lyrics and smooth beats. 

DJ Zenas is known for his versatility, creativity, and superb craftsmanship in creating excellent music, which makes him an artist to peek out.
